short_description: Your Bluesky or Mastodon follower count in large digits on your BUSY Bar.
description:
## How to use

- In the app's settings, choose the network and enter your handle, such as bsky.app on Bluesky or Gargron@mastodon.social on Mastodon.
- Turn the wheel to switch between followers, following and posts.

## What you see

The network's logo, the Bluesky butterfly or the Mastodon bubble, and the count in large digits. The app updates it every 10 minutes.

## Data

The public Bluesky and Mastodon APIs, no account or key needed.
changelog: First release: Bluesky and Mastodon, followers, following and posts.
